searchText: What is the need for it? I'm generally against adding introspection into EVM behavior because it makes it harder to change EVM behavior in the future. For example, maybe some future transaction type doesn't have a nonce. I have a spicy pull request that is likely to require some debate <@!425279588009246720> <@683653554631868440> <@543900561460822016>: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4601 Oh, super valid point. The reason that I was thinking about was to use it as a deterministic pointer as laid out here: https://zefram.xyz/posts/how-i-almost-cheesed-the-evm/#second-idea-deterministically-shifting-pointer
